ev.q: Among approximately 8.8 million health care personnel working in 4,114 acute care hospitals, influenza vaccination coverage was 80.7% overall
influenza vaccination coverage was 80.7% among acute care hospital personnel and 45.4% among nursing home personnel
coverage was lowest (65.7%) among licensed independent practitioners
Results were further stratified by employment category
Acute care hospitals and nursing homes report data to NHSN according to surveillance protocols

methods_quotes.q: Pooled mean vaccination coverage with influenza and COVID-19 was calculated as the number of health care personnel who reported receipt of each recommended vaccine
Facilities that reported data for both vaccine types were included in the analysis.
95% CIs were calculated using the mid-P method.
results were categorized into levels based on the overall quintile distribution of coverage across both vaccines and both facility types.
